events.name: Seattle Sounders FC at Vancouver Whitecaps

headlines.description: Brian White scored two goals and Ryan Gauld finished with a goal and two assists as the Vancouver Whitecaps cruised to a 5-1 victory over Seattle Sounders FC on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Caps rout Sounders to leave Seattle clinging to last playoff spot in West

events.name: Toronto FC at Atlanta United FC

headlines.description: Miguel Almiron and Alexey Miranchuk each had a goal and an assist, Cooper Sanchez also scored and Atlanta United beat Toronto FC 3-1 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Atlanta United eliminates Toronto FC from playoff contention with 3-1 victory

events.name: Red Bull New York at Nashville SC
Inter Miami CF at New England Revolution

headlines.description: Lionel Messi had a second-half assist before scoring the winner as Inter Miami CF came from behind to beat the New England Revolution 2-1 on Sunday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Messi rallies Miami to win over Revs to go second in East
